description: The section face: shell sand banded with dark floors; crane down
vo_text: Sand has buried layers of prehistoric life here. Dig through them and the team can follow what happened to the same patch of ground over centuries. Farmers ploughed it. People buried their dead in it. Later, they built houses over it.

description: Lab macro: the healed upper jaw, smooth bone where the molars were
vo_text: The owner of the skull lost his upper chewing teeth years before he died. The bone around those empty sockets has healed. But the teeth in the lower jaw show that they were still meeting teeth above them.

description: Sampling for isotopes: a drill hole in the thigh bone, bone powder, sample tubes
vo_text: Chemical analysis adds another mismatch. The skull and jaw have a different isotopic signature from the leg bone. Together with the physical evidence, the tests reveal parts from three men.

description: The grave at last light: the head of one man above the body of another
